label: Week 2
method: Saturday rollup of nightly search_news + counts; items already filter-passed; no invented nights
headline: Week 2’s loudest room was Buffalo–Detroit: the Bills–Lions Thursday shootout and the leftover Texans opener kept both Buffalo and Detroit on top of the board all week. Dallas’s NFC East noise (injury sheets, Cooper Rush talk, the Giants hangover) and Philadelphia’s Woolen debut / Dickerson IR / Nashville road trip filled the next tier. Kansas City’s Broncos leftover and Tyreek reunion chatter, Chicago’s 59-point hangover, Cleveland’s Sanders–Horn practice-squad buzz, and New England’s Doubs / Henderson chatter rounded out the sticky rooms; New York and Baltimore stayed in the volume mix on Giants–Cowboys fallout and Ravens injury chatter. All seven nights logged. Quiet clubs stayed quiet. Vibe only.
